playback: Ten one-shot gestures; each begins and finishes at neutral rest with all four morph weights zero.
tone: Playful pirate teasing with a friendly face, a rigid cloth hat and elastic slime motion.

clips.name: Taunt_HatTip
clips.gesture: Tips the rigid hat while the body stays composed, then returns it to its resting position.

clips.name: Taunt_BellyLaugh
clips.gesture: Three uneven laugh pulses compress and lift the elastic body.
clips.expression: An open smile and a closed eye.

clips.name: Taunt_SideEye
clips.gesture: Turns slowly to the side by 32 degrees and holds the look before returning.

clips.name: Taunt_NopeWag
clips.gesture: Three quick alternating yaw movements suggest a mischievous refusal.

clips.name: Taunt_Peekaboo
clips.gesture: Tilts the rigid hat by 68 degrees, moves it 0.65 meters forward and 0.30 meters down to conceal the eye, then pops it back up twice.
clips.expression: Two concealed peeks followed by playful reveals.

clips.name: Taunt_MockBow
clips.gesture: Makes a theatrical whole-body bow of 30 degrees, then rises cheekily.

clips.name: Taunt_Swagger
clips.gesture: Two lateral hops alternate the body lean and finish at the original position.

clips.name: Taunt_TongueTease
clips.gesture: The actual rounded tongue extends from a partly opened mouth, then retracts.
clips.expression: A squint and a gentle tongue-out tease.

clips.name: Taunt_VictoryLap
clips.gesture: One complete 360-degree turn follows a small orbit and ends with a hat salute.

clips.name: Taunt_FakeSleep
clips.gesture: Settles into a slow tilted doze, then startles awake at 2.05 seconds.
clips.expression: A closed eye during the doze, reopening during the startle.

validation: The optimization audit records per-target morph ranges, neutral resets and distinct normalized trajectory hashes; native QA samples the actual exported clips.
